snippet.title: Version 3.3 Teaser - "Journey to the Sky" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
Dracaene, so wise and clear-headed...
May your wisdom part the fog of the unknown, so that people may see the path ahead.
Lindverne... Bold and fearless, with a heart full of courage...
May your passion keep the flame burning bright, so that the long, cold night may never feel so endless anymore.
Eldreda... my most steadfast, devoted child...
May your sense of duty no longer leave you standing alone. May they love you as deeply as you love them.
Just as you would give everything for their sake.

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5·iOS·Android·PC·Xbox·Steam｜Version 3.2 "Their Secret Histories" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
